blocks.prompt: 5. Sum the series \(2 + (1 - i) + \left(\frac{1}{i}\right) + \cdots\) to 8 terms.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh complex numbers wali geometric series hai (\(i^{2} = -1\)).
Plan: pehle \(\frac{1}{i}\) ko simplify karenge, \(r\) nikal kar check karenge, \(r^{8}\) baar baar square kar ke nikalenge, phir \(S_8 = \frac{a_1(1 - r^{8})}{1 - r}\) lagayenge aur aakhir mein neeche se \(i\) hatayenge (rationalise).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(2 + (1 - i) + \frac{1}{i} + \cdots\), 8 terms.
Humein find karna hai: \(S_8\).
Tareeqa: Pehle dikhana hai ke yeh G.P. hai, phir sum ka formula. G.P. ke formule complex numbers par bhi wese hi chalte hain, bas \(i^{2} = -1\) yaad rakhna hai.

\(\frac{1}{i}\) ko simplify karein
\[\dfrac{1}{i} = \dfrac{i}{i^{2}} = \dfrac{i}{-1} = -i\]
Kyun: Neeche \(i\) ho to kaam mushkil hota hai. Upar neeche \(i\) se multiply kiya to neeche \(i^{2} = -1\) aaya. Ab series \(2 + (1 - i) + (-i) + \cdots\) hai.

\(r\) nikal kar check karein
\[r = \dfrac{1 - i}{2}\]
\[(1 - i) \cdot \dfrac{1 - i}{2} = \dfrac{1 - 2i + i^{2}}{2} = \dfrac{-2i}{2} = -i\]
Kyun: \(r\) = doosra term taqseem pehla term. Check ke liye doosre term ko \(r\) se multiply kiya to teesra term \(-i\) mila. Ratio barabar hai, is liye yeh G.P. hai.
Dhyan dein: \((1 - i)^{2}\) mein \(i^{2} = -1\) rakhna na bhoolein: \(1 - 2i - 1 = -2i\).

\(r^{8}\) baar baar square kar ke
\[r^{2} = \dfrac{(1 - i)^{2}}{4} = \dfrac{-2i}{4} = -\dfrac{i}{2}\]
\[r^{4} = \left(-\dfrac{i}{2}\right)^{2} = -\dfrac{1}{4}\]
\[r^{8} = \left(-\dfrac{1}{4}\right)^{2} = \dfrac{1}{16}\]
Kyun: 8th power seedha nikalna lamba hai. \(r^{2}\), phir us ka square \(r^{4}\), phir us ka square \(r^{8}\): sirf teen qadam. \(\left(-\frac{i}{2}\right)^{2} = \frac{i^{2}}{4} = -\frac{1}{4}\).

\(1 - r\) nikalein
\[1 - r = \dfrac{2 - (1 - i)}{2} = \dfrac{1 + i}{2}\]
Kyun: 1 ko \(\frac{2}{2}\) likha taake dono ka denominator 2 ho jaye. Bracket ke aage minus hai, is liye \(-(1 - i) = -1 + i\), aur \(2 - 1 + i = 1 + i\).

Sum ka formula lagayein
\[S_8 = \dfrac{2\left(1 - \frac{1}{16}\right)}{\frac{1 + i}{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{15}{8} \cdot \dfrac{2}{1 + i} = \dfrac{15}{4(1 + i)}\]
Kyun: \(a_1 = 2\), \(1 - \frac{1}{16} = \frac{15}{16}\), aur \(2 \cdot \frac{15}{16} = \frac{15}{8}\). Fraction \(\frac{1 + i}{2}\) se divide karna \(\frac{2}{1 + i}\) se multiply karna hai.

Neeche se \(i\) hatayein
\[S_8 = \dfrac{15(1 - i)}{4(1 + i)(1 - i)}\]
\[= \dfrac{15(1 - i)}{4 \times 2} = \dfrac{15(1 - i)}{8}\]
Kyun: Neeche \(1 + i\) ka conjugate (ulte sign wala saathi) \(1 - i\) hai. Upar neeche us se multiply karne par neeche \((1 + i)(1 - i) = 1 - i^{2} = 1 + 1 = 2\), yani real number aa jata hai.

Tasdeeq: aathon terms jama karein
\[2,\ 1 - i,\ -i,\ \tfrac{-1 - i}{2},\ -\tfrac{1}{2},\ \tfrac{-1 + i}{4},\ \tfrac{i}{4},\ \tfrac{1 + i}{8}\]
\[\text{real: } \tfrac{15}{8},\ \ \text{imaginary: } -\tfrac{15}{8}\]
Kyun: Har term pichle ko \(r\) se multiply kar ke bana. Real hisse: \(2 + 1 - \frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{8} = \frac{15}{8}\). Imaginary hisse: \(-1 - 1 - \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{8} = -\frac{15}{8}\). Yani sum \(\frac{15}{8} - \frac{15}{8}i = \frac{15(1 - i)}{8}\).
